Rapide-Rate Thermal Cycle Chamber
Product catalog summary
Overview
The document details the TCC-150 Rapid-Rate Thermal Cycle Chamber, designed for rapid temperature changes in specimens, suitable for applications including JEDEC standard tests. It features a consistent and repeatable temperature change rate, utilizing advanced technologies for specimen temperature and ramp control.
Performance
The TCC-150 ensures uniform temperature load and repeatable temperature change rates. It minimizes temperature variations by simulating wind volume and speed, achieving a specimen temperature ramp rate of 15℃/min and an air temperature ramp rate of 23℃/min. It complies with the JEDEC JESD22-A104-B standard for semiconductor package and solder joint evaluation.
Temperature Control
The chamber employs a sensor for specimen temperature measurement and a high-speed controller for precise control. It enhances refrigeration capacity at low temperatures, reduces temperature differences between specimen and air, and ensures uniform airflow speed.
Safety and Environmental Features
The TCC-150 includes safety features such as an alarm for unsecured doors, recyclable material identifiers, and uses HFC refrigerant safe for the ozone layer. Optional features include a paperless recorder for temperature data.
Instrumentation
The chamber is equipped with a color LCD touch-screen system for simplified operation, offering three modes: Program Operation, Constant Operation, and Cycle Operation. Instrumentation is door-mounted to minimize footprint.
Specifications
The chamber supports a wide range of applications and includes various safety devices and accessories. It offers options for paperless recording and future installation of temperature recorders.
Dimensions and Options
The document provides detailed dimensions and optional accessories such as paperless recorders, specimen baskets, and safety devices.
Options and Accessories
Fixture for Securing Body: Used to bolt the chamber to the floor.
Caster: Facilitates movement with 4 casters and 4 adjustable feet.
Chamber Dew Tray: Prevents water leaks onto the floor.
Communication Cable: Options include RS-485, GPIB, and RS-232C for continuous PC control.
Power Cord: Available in 5 m and 10 m lengths.
Additional Cable Port: Can be added on the sides of the chamber.
Cable Port Rubber Plug: Provided with the cable port.
Specimen Basket/Shelf Bracket: Equivalent to standard accessories.
Emergency Stop Switch: Immediately stops the chamber.
External Alarm Terminal: Notifies a remote alarm if the safety device activates.
Additional Overheat Protector: Prevents abnormal temperature rise.
Integrating Hour Meter with Reset: Can be reset if necessary.
Overcool Protector: Stops operation if temperature decreases excessively.
Recorder Terminal: Outputs temperature data.
Specimen Temperature Measuring Thermocouple: Type T thermocouple for measuring specimen temperature.
